source.author: ov
source.text: Viderat a patrio redeuntem Iuppiter illam flumine et o virgo Iove digna tuoque beatum nescio quem factura toro, pete dixerat umbras altorum nemorum et nemorum monstraverat umbras, dum calet et medio sol est altissimus orbe.
source.text_original: Viderat a patrio redeuntem Iuppiter illam / flumine et 'o virgo Iove digna tuoque beatum / nescio quem factura toro, pete' dixerat 'umbras / altorum nemorum' (et nemorum monstraverat umbras), / 'dum calet et medio sol est altissimus orbe.
source.text_english: Jupiter had seen her returning from her father’s stream, and, O maiden worthy of Jupiter and about to make some unknown man blessed by your couch, he had said, Go to the shades of the lofty groves, and had shown her the shades of the groves, while it is hot and the sun is highest in the middle of its course.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: moliri hunc puppem iubet et demittere ferro robora, Peliacas et iam comes exit in umbras.
reuse.text_original: moliri hunc puppem iubet et demittere ferro / robora, Peliacas et iam comes exit in umbras.
reuse.text_english: He orders this ship to be launched and the timbers to be cut down with iron, and as companion he already goes forth into the shades of Pelias.
